activity_statements.statement: operates an international chain of membership-only warehouse clubs providing nationally-branded and Kirkland Signature private-label merchandise at substantially lower prices than conventional retail
charges annual membership fees (Executive, Business, Gold Star at $65 in the US) generating a high-margin recurring revenue stream that funds low-margin merchandise sales
operates self-service gasoline stations at warehouse locations across the US, Canada, Australia, Japan, UK, Spain, Mexico, Taiwan and Iceland
operates Costco Wholesale Industries manufacturing businesses including food packaging, optical laboratories, meat processing and jewelry distribution to supply members at lower cost
runs Costco.com e-commerce platform serving members online alongside physical warehouse locations worldwide
achieves profitability through volume purchasing, efficient distribution and no-frills self-service warehouse formats enabling low gross margins offset by membership fee income

name_reality_gap: Labeled Retail & Wholesale; what the evidence shows is a membership-fee business model where profit is primarily driven by annual fees rather than merchandise margins, plus manufacturing subsidiaries in food processing and optical labs that a retail label hides entirely.
extraction_notes: Main costco.com pages returned JS shells; investor relations pages were highly informative with detailed business model description. Manufacturing subsidiaries (food, optical, meat, jewelry) are concrete and verifiable.
